title: BIM Modeler / BIM Coordinator
description:
* Develop and prepare architectural designs and detailed 3D models using BIM software such as Revit, AutoCAD, and Navisworks.
* Convert rough sketches, drawings, and technical specifications into precise, detailed 3D models.
* Collaborate closely with architects, structural and MEP engineers, project managers, and other stakeholders to gather all information required to build accurate models.
* Update, revise, and modify existing models promptly in response to revised plans, specifications, and design change requests.
* Generate and extract 2D drawings, sections, elevations, and construction details from 3D models for use in construction documentation.
* Run clash detection using Navisworks (or equivalent), analyze conflicts between disciplines, and generate detailed clash reports.
* Facilitate and actively participate in BIM coordination meetings, presenting clash reports and proposing resolutions.
* Ensure all models and deliverables comply with project BIM standards, execution plans (BEP), and company protocols.
* Manage version control, ensuring multiple iterations of models are properly stored, labeled, and tracked throughout the project lifecycle.
* Utilize BIM software and linked data to assist with project scheduling (4D), cost estimation (5D), and material quantity tracking.
* Create, maintain, and continuously update the organization's BIM component library, including custom families and templates.
* Support quality control checks on models to identify and correct errors, omissions, or inconsistencies before submission.
* Coordinate with surveyors and site teams where necessary to validate as-built conditions against models.
* Participate in internal team meetings, providing regular progress updates and flagging coordination issues early.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
